narr: Widespread showers and thunderstorms slowly moved across southeast Iowa on the morning of July 26th. These showers and storms produced widespread heavy rainfall of 2 to 4 inches. This produced flash flooding at several locations in Lee County.
ev: Department of Highways reports that 263rd Ave in Lee County was closed due to high water.
Department of Highways reports that 240th Avenue is closed from Hwy 2 to 235th St until further notice due to high water and flash flooding.
Flooding across the road and bridge has caused 220th St. to be closed until further notice from Golden Road to Wilson Lake Park.
The Department of Highways reported that 170th Street closed from 140th Ave. to 150th Ave. due to high water and flooding.
Department of Highways reported that 240th St to 265th Ave closed due to water over the road.
